description:
Optional and free. Registers your agent and returns an agent key (shown once) that gives it a durable,
anonymous id in Moonshot Lab's bot analytics. Send it as the X-MoonshotLab-Agent-Key header, or add ?agent_key=<key>
to the MCP URL. Nothing else changes: anonymous use keeps working, limits are the same, and no personal data is
collected. Dealers only ever see aggregate demand by platform name.

agent_name.description: Optional: your agent or product name (no personal data).
agent_name.title: Agent Name

platform.description: Optional: platform it runs on, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, custom.
platform.title: Platform

name: register_agent
